summary: R238 extracts a dedicated current programmable VS/PS bytecode-pair inventory from existing detailed DX11 census signatures and keeps coverage fail-closed when signature detail/hash caps or shader introspection gaps make the inventory incomplete.

C0_RECOVER.evidence: Recovered authenticated GitHub vr-dx11-native-r71 HEAD e43981f939e0f67ac98500e52f91166d62c1f33d; read AGENTS.md, VR backend review index/Set05, queue controller contract, branch-local conversion state and current DX11 plan. R237 is complete and not repeated.

C1_REVIEW.finding: Current R85 detailed signatures already carry D3D9 VS/PS byte size, version token and bytecode hash, but the analyzer exposes them only inside raw full-pipeline signature strings. The dominant programmable path therefore lacks a dedicated pair inventory for the next translation/object-cache stage, and detail-cap skips can hide pairs unless coverage is tracked separately.

review_lenses.architecture: Analyzer-only extraction from existing runtime evidence; no new draw-time instrumentation and no vr-d3d9ex-focus edits.
review_lenses.ownership_lifetime: No COM/resource/cache lifetime changes; raw runtime shader objects are not retained or cached.
review_lenses.performance: No runtime hot-path work; pair dedupe is offline in analyze_dx11_census.py.
review_lenses.adversarial: A signature detail-cap skip must leave programmable-pair EvidenceCoverageComplete=false even when R235/R236 signature count accounting is otherwise complete.

C2_IMPLEMENT.evidence: Parse the existing R85 shader identity block, dedupe complete programmable VS/PS bytecode pairs across current signature records, export pair metadata and signature references, and fail pair-coverage completeness closed on detail/hash caps, missing shader blocks, introspection failure or mixed pairs. Added positive dedupe and detail-cap regressions plus source-graph drift guards.

C3_VALIDATE.evidence: Local auxiliary validation will run analyzer regressions and source-graph checks before publication; the required exact-SHA Backend Conversion Gate remains authoritative for Win32 build/binary and DX11 readiness smoke. No Quest 3/VDXR runtime test performed.

C5_PACKAGE.reason: Offline census analyzer/evidence shaping only; no runtime distributable identity change.

C6_STATE.exact_next_action: Publish the R238 material result without CI skip and require its exact-SHA Backend Conversion Gate; after PASS, finalize run/lane bookkeeping while preserving RUNTIME_VALIDATION=UNTESTED.

regression_assessment.evidence: Only offline analyzer/test/verifier and task bookkeeping paths change. Runtime renderer, shader binding, resource lifetime and transport paths remain untouched.
